claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place from Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
The main show starts at 6 p.m. ET on both nights.
The main show starts at 3 p.m. PT on both nights.
A kickoff/countdown show begins at 3 p.m. ET.
A kickoff/countdown show begins at noon PT.
The entire two-day event streams on ESPN Unlimited in the U.S.
The entire two-day event streams on Netflix internationally.
The first hour airs on ESPN2 on Night 1.
The main event of Night 1 on April 18 is Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE Championship.
Night 1 includes a tag team match featuring IShowSpeed.
The main event of Night 2 on April 19 is CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship.
